confirmedFinding.problem: Bazi and Ziwei cleared their saved record ID after any failed PUT, so a retry after timeout or HTTP 500 could insert a duplicate record.
confirmedFinding.fix: Clear the record ID only for the API's NOT_FOUND error, and only if the same input object is still displayed.
confirmedFinding.afterFix: All eight regressions pass in the final 62-test run.

environmentIncidents.classification: Agent-caused verification environment incident, not an original product defect
environmentIncidents.description: Bundled pnpm run implicitly invoked dependency installation and moved npm-managed dependencies into node_modules/.ignored; restricted network prevented that installation from finishing.
environmentIncidents.resolution: Stopped the verification invocations and restored 54 original package directories in frontend and backend. No packages were upgraded and no lockfile changes were introduced by recovery. Verified Dart Sass 1.97.1 compilation, then used direct local CLI entry points only.

environmentIncidents.description: A new retry assertion sometimes queried a stale globally active Pinia after async work. Diagnostic output confirmed that the store captured by the page still held recordId 11.
environmentIncidents.resolution: The new tests now assert against the store captured before page creation, plus persisted cache and outgoing request method/URL.

environmentIncidents.description: One parallel frontend test run failed because esbuild could not allocate a Go heap arena at startup.
environmentIncidents.resolution: The original six test files were rerun with --test-concurrency=1 and passed 62/62.
